title: TX queue: document and enforce destroy quiescence contract
description: Round-2 correctness review found tx_queue_destroy() is not an atomic lifecycle transition: tx_queue_clear() unlocks before pool and mutex teardown, so a concurrent push can enter during destruction. The public type is described as thread-safe but destroy has no external-quiescence precondition. Document that callers must stop/join all queue users before destroy and ensure production L2 follows this ordering; add a lifecycle assertion/state guard if feasible without changing the per-context design.
acceptance_criteria: Public destroy documentation explicitly requires exclusive ownership/no concurrent operations; production teardown visibly quiesces workers before destroy; tests cover the supported lifecycle and no code claims concurrent destroy safety.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by host sanitizer suite plus review cycle; superseding round-4 findings are tracked separately
